note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Only one supplied datum (a subject tag) is substituted; no legal consequence is inferred.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Three fictional activities after the filter, one per bin (the Transport bin is empty). The context shrinks to a miniature and a detail window enlarges the second card ('Street concert', tag 'Culture', not listed); its tag is replaced by 'Transport' (listed). Back in context only that card is re-sorted, into the empty Transport bin, and a changed-datum marker stays.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the inverse substitution — the second card's listed tag 'Housing' is replaced by 'Sports', which the list does not classify; the card is re-sorted from its bin into the (empty) side bin, with a stronger zoom.
